name: gap-diffusion
description: Two neurons with one gap junction, identity local dynamics, v = (1, 0), g = 2, dt = 0.1.
derivation: Section 6.6 with w = x: v_i' = (v_i + dt g v_j) / (1 + dt g), evaluated exactly with rational arithmetic from the old values for four steps (the sum is conserved for two nodes, the difference shrinks by (1 - dt g)/(1 + dt g) per step).
